label: 斩击
phaseObservations: largest crescent with pointed trailing cuts
requirement: Preserve crescent orientation and open inner arc; expansion and fragmentation must be authored, not whole-image scaling.

label: 穿刺
phaseObservations: narrow ivory puncture with two dark chips
faint needle and small residual chips
requirement: Keep puncture axis and lower impact point fixed; do not translate the whole frame to fake motion.

label: 箭矢命中
requirement: Impact point tracks the arrow tip, not the individual bbox center; no bow or unrelated target body.

label: 钝击
phaseObservations: small ochre elliptical ring and side dust
peak dust ring with flying stone flecks
requirement: Use a stable ground-impact center, growing ring then decay; no solid opaque disk.

label: 普通火焰
phaseObservations: small dying flame and loose embers
requirement: Hold the flame root fixed while height changes; a flame tongue can be luminous but no rectangular glow.

label: 琥珀誓火
phaseObservations: ring broken into floating amber fragments
requirement: Preserve angular oath segments and open center; this is not generic orange fire or a sunburst.

label: 攻城碎屑
phaseObservations: dense airborne wood and stone explosion
requirement: Ballistic down/out trajectory then settlement; do not arbitrarily reverse to small-to-large generic four phases.

label: 亡者记忆冲击
phaseObservations: cluster of gray human echoes, gray wisps and amber papers
faint dissolving echoes and loose papers
requirement: Preserve ordinary-person memory silhouettes/name-paper semantics; avoid replacing them with a generic blue skull.

label: 秋雨
phaseObservations: droplets near ground with first specks
requirement: Loop must hand off residual specks to new falling droplets; transparent negative space, no white source panel.
specialRisks: Loop seam requires actual review; no current consumer instantiates it.

label: 河流浅水
phaseObservations: two stones with narrow blue ripple
requirement: Keep two stone positions fixed; authored outward wave and repeat seam, no opaque water tile.
specialRisks: Loop seam requires actual review; no current consumer instantiates it.

label: 荒原强风
phaseObservations: long ochre wind ribbon with grass flecks
requirement: Maintain drift direction and rhythmic seam; muted translucent gusts, not a solid background.
specialRisks: Loop seam requires actual review; no current consumer instantiates it.

label: 山炉热浪
phaseObservations: three thin amber heat wisps above a coal line
requirement: Coals/heat origin stable; wisp deformation and continuous loop, no full-tile opaque heat haze.
specialRisks: Loop seam requires actual review; no current consumer instantiates it.

label: 焦土余火
phaseObservations: small cracks glowing and rising smoke
requirement: Cracked earth is a source-semantic compact motif, not permission for unrelated opaque backing; keep patch stable.

label: 墓园污染
phaseObservations: low green-gray fumes above soil/name papers
rising twisting fumes and lifted papers
requirement: Retain name papers and restrained graveyard fumes; source soil patch is semantic, not a full rectangle.

label: 银林灵火
phaseObservations: small pale-green wisp above leaf litter
peak leafy spirit flame with curling branch
requirement: Hold leaf-bed root; preserve sage/leaf identity with controlled translucent light.

label: 七塔灰光
phaseObservations: small tower with short gray rays
largest tall gray ray fan and stones
requirement: Tower is original semantic subject; gray rays come from its amber top. Source peak touches the top crop boundary, requiring overflow review.
specialRisks: Source maximum gray beam contacts crop top; original crop may clip peak.

label: 治疗
phaseObservations: small sage leaf orbit, bandages and plus
requirement: Keep medical plus and restrained sage motifs; true translucent glow is allowed, no yellow/white opaque panel.

label: 受控
requirement: This is closure/restraint, not burst-and-vanish; loop remains false under current contract.

label: 隐蔽
requirement: Density should genuinely dissipate; translucent fog can have no near-opaque core.

label: 援护盾
phaseObservations: small amber impact spark on arc
peak spark spray on shield arc
requirement: Preserve narrow blocking crescent and stable contact; do not insert a shield bearer or opaque backing.

label: 结构受损

requirement: Original board has unrelated gray/white vignette backing; recreate fragments/dust only with genuine alpha.
specialRisks: Opaque/cloudy panel backing in original board; cannot treat its existing RGBA mode or keyed intermediate as proof of genuine alpha.
